author: m. h. jacobson
title: Georgia Street to close for roadwork between Lock Drive B and Parker Street May 27
text:
Georgia Street in Monroe will be closed to through traffic between Lock Drive B and Parker Street beginning May 27 at 8:30 a.m. to allow crews to perform work along the edge of the roadway, according to a statement from Kenneth Rogers, Project Manager for the City of Monroe.
The closure is expected to remain in effect until Thursday morning, May 28, weather permitting, or until the work is complete. Barricades and traffic control measures will be placed and maintained throughout the closure period to ensure safety for motorists and pedestrians.
Motorists are encouraged by city officials to plan alternate routes during this time and travel accordingly. “We understand that this may create a short-term inconvenience. The City of Monroe thanks you in advance for your patience while work is in process and reminds you to drive with caution while in the work area. Be advised that it is illegal to drive around barricades,” said Rogers.
The city has provided contact information for questions regarding the project: Kenneth Rogers can be reached at 318-376-3559.
